page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Top: a large title block in capitals, set in three to four lines, partly mirrored. Middle: a framed woodcut or engraving, described under notes. Below the engraving: a few small lines of text and a short rule with a line beneath it. No running head, page number or signature.
page.notes: The title block at the top is mirrored, which points to show-through from the reverse side of the leaf, so the lines cannot be read reliably. The middle lines are faint and cannot be read letter by letter. The centre of the page carries a framed woodcut or engraving, faint and blue-grey, with no legible text inside it. Below it are a few small lines and a short rule, also illegible. The page is stained and foxed throughout, with a dark band at the right edge.
